discovery.selection: first reachable eligible per focal trajectory; hashed among different-from placements of same ordinary tile with unequal own individual-tile mobility; at least 3 focal tiles
discovery.worldSeedFormula: mixSeed32(seed xor imul(turn+1,0x9e3779b9) xor imul(seat+1,0x85ebca6b) xor imul(worldIndex+1,0xc2b2ae35))
discovery.comparison: high vs low own individually playable remaining tile count; exactly same discarded tile/pips/hand and opened-number state, differing only in chosen branch end
discovery.assumptions: Uniform unseen tiles conditional on observed no-stock passes, no prior policy-choice likelihood. Branch-opening semantics provisional.
discovery.limitations: First-eligible selection, simplistic fixed continuation bots, no block winner, finish-first not match win, exploratory CIs without multiple-testing correction.
